title: RNA-seq on AML patient samples and umbilical cord blood derived CD34+
description: We aim to identify differentially expressed genes between AML patient samples and normal hematopoeitic progenitor cells. Overall design: In collaboration with Girihlet, we performed RNA-seq on sorted blasts from 7 AML patient samples and sorted CD34+ cells from UCB after 72 hours of culture in StemSpan media with TPO, Flt3L, SCF
